requestBody.useCaseSummary: Swoop sends SMS auto-replies when home-service businesses miss customer calls. Customer dials business, call goes unanswered, Swoop texts back within seconds to coordinate a service appointment (1-7 msgs per missed call). First msg includes business name, service description, frequency, Msg&data rates apply, Reply STOP to end, HELP for help, and Terms URL (welcomematdigital.com/swoop). Consent is implied by inbound call. Opt-in flow: welcomematdigital.com/swoop/consent.html
requestBody.productionMessageSample: Mike's Plumbing here, returning your missed call. We'll send up to 7 msgs to coordinate. Msg&data rates may apply. Reply STOP to end, HELP for help. Terms: welcomematdigital.com/swoop
requestBody.additionalInformation: Consent is recorded on the lead record with consent_method, consent_source, consent_recorded_at, consent_script_version, consent_notes, and outbound confirmation SMS body/Twilio SID.
requestBody.optInConfirmationMessage: Mike's Plumbing: You're opted in to receive service-related text messages about your inquiry, estimate, appointment, or follow-up. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Msg&data rates may apply.
requestBody.helpMessageSample: Mike's Plumbing: Reply HELP for help or call (833) 783-0902. For privacy info, visit welcomematdigital.com/swoop/privacy.html. Reply STOP to opt out. Msg&data rates may apply.
